title: Wave Speed
description: Links frequency and wavelength through the propagation speed of the medium.

title: Period
description: Duration of a single cycle — the time-domain counterpart of frequency.

title: Frequency from Period
description: Calculates the number of complete cycles occurring each second.

title: Wavelength
description: Calculates the physical length of one complete wave cycle.

title: Frequency from Wavelength
description: Finds frequency when wavelength and propagation speed are known.

title: Speed of Sound in Air
description: Estimates the speed of sound in dry air based on temperature.

title: Sound Pressure Level
description: Expresses measured sound pressure relative to the standard acoustic reference pressure.

title: Pressure from SPL
description: Converts sound pressure level back into physical RMS pressure.

title: Amplitude Level Difference
description: Calculates the decibel difference between two amplitude quantities.

title: Power Level Difference
description: Calculates the decibel difference between two power quantities.

title: Intensity
description: Describes acoustic power distributed across a given surface area.

title: Inverse-Square Intensity
description: Estimates how sound intensity changes with distance from an ideal point source.

title: Level Change with Distance
description: Calculates the theoretical SPL change between two distances in free-field conditions.

title: Room Mode — Axial
description: Calculates axial resonances between two parallel room boundaries.

title: General Room Mode
description: Calculates modal frequencies using all three room dimensions.

title: Phase Shift from Distance
description: Converts a path-length difference into phase difference for a given wavelength.

title: Phase Shift from Time Delay
description: Calculates phase offset produced by a time delay at a particular frequency.

title: Time Delay from Distance
description: Calculates how long sound takes to travel a specified distance.

title: Distance from Delay
description: Converts sound-travel time into distance.

title: Harmonic Frequency
description: Calculates the frequency of any harmonic from the fundamental.

title: Octave Relationship
description: Calculates frequency after moving a specified number of octaves.

title: Semitone Frequency Ratio
description: Calculates a frequency after moving a number of equal-tempered semitones.

title: BPM to Beat Duration
description: Calculates the duration of one beat in seconds.

title: BPM to Milliseconds
description: Calculates the duration of one quarter-note beat in milliseconds.

title: Note Duration
description: Calculates note duration for common rhythmic divisions.

title: RMS Value
description: Calculates the effective magnitude of a varying signal.

title: Sine RMS
description: Converts peak amplitude of an ideal sine wave to RMS amplitude.

title: Crest Factor
description: Shows the difference between peak and RMS levels.

title: Nyquist Frequency
description: Defines the highest theoretical frequency boundary for a sampled system.

title: FFT Frequency Resolution
description: Calculates the spacing between FFT frequency bins.

title: Theoretical PCM Dynamic Range
description: Estimates the ideal dynamic range of linear PCM audio from its bit depth.

title: Digital Sample Count
description: Calculates how many samples are stored during a given recording duration.

title: Uncompressed PCM File Size
description: Estimates the raw size of an uncompressed PCM recording.

title: Filter Octave Distance
description: Calculates the number of octaves between two frequencies.

title: Q Factor
description: Describes how narrow or broad a resonant or filter band is.

title: Bandwidth from Q
description: Calculates approximate bandwidth around a filter's center frequency.

title: Sound Intensity Level
description: Expresses acoustic intensity relative to the standard reference intensity.

title: Sound Power Level
description: Expresses acoustic power relative to the standard reference sound power.

title: Pressure Ratio from Decibels
description: Converts a decibel difference into a sound-pressure or amplitude ratio.

title: Power Ratio from Decibels
description: Converts a decibel difference into a power ratio.

title: Combined Sound Level
description: Combines multiple independent sound levels into one total level.

title: Two Equal Independent Sources
description: Shows the level increase when two equal, uncorrelated sound sources are combined.

title: Linear Gain from dB
description: Converts an amplitude gain expressed in decibels into a linear multiplier.

title: dB from Linear Gain
description: Converts a linear amplitude multiplier into decibels.

title: Digital Level in dBFS
description: Expresses digital signal amplitude relative to full scale.

title: Digital Headroom
description: Calculates the remaining peak margin before digital full scale.

title: Signal-to-Noise Ratio
description: Compares signal amplitude with background-noise amplitude.

title: Total Harmonic Distortion
description: Measures harmonic distortion relative to the fundamental component.

title: Angular Frequency
description: Converts ordinary frequency into angular frequency.

title: Wavenumber
description: Describes how rapidly wave phase changes with distance.

title: Phase Velocity
description: Links angular frequency and wavenumber through wave propagation speed.

title: Samples per Cycle
description: Calculates how many digital samples represent one period of a tone.

title: Frequency from Samples per Cycle
description: Calculates tone frequency from its period measured in samples.

title: Delay in Samples
description: Converts a time delay into a number of digital samples.

title: Delay from Phase Shift
description: Calculates the time delay corresponding to a phase difference at one frequency.

title: Comb-Filter Spacing
description: Calculates the spacing between repeating peaks or notches created by a delayed copy of a signal.

title: Delay from Comb Spacing
description: Calculates the delay that produces a given comb-filter frequency spacing.

title: Quarter Wavelength
description: Calculates one quarter of a wavelength, useful in resonance and acoustic-treatment estimates.

title: Half Wavelength
description: Calculates one half of a wavelength for standing-wave and resonance analysis.

title: Quarter-Wave Resonance
description: Estimates the fundamental resonance of a tube closed at one end or a quarter-wave resonator.

title: Half-Wave Resonance
description: Estimates the fundamental resonance of an ideal open-open or closed-closed resonant path.

title: Helmholtz Resonance
description: Estimates the resonance frequency of a cavity connected through a neck or port.

title: Equivalent Absorption Area
description: Calculates the total equivalent absorption area of room surfaces.

title: Sabine Reverberation Time
description: Estimates the time required for sound level in a diffuse room to decay by 60 dB.

title: Schroeder Frequency
description: Estimates the transition between distinct room-mode behavior and a denser reverberant field.

title: Acoustic Impedance
description: Describes the relationship between acoustic pressure and particle velocity.

title: Plane-Wave Particle Velocity
description: Estimates particle velocity from sound pressure in an ideal plane wave.

title: Plane-Wave Intensity
description: Calculates acoustic intensity from RMS sound pressure for an ideal plane wave.

title: Spherical-Wave Intensity
description: Estimates sound intensity at a distance from an ideal omnidirectional point source.

title: Sound Power from Intensity
description: Calculates acoustic power from measured intensity around an ideal spherical source.

title: Reflection Coefficient
description: Estimates the pressure reflection coefficient at a boundary between two acoustic impedances.

title: Reflected Intensity Ratio
description: Calculates the fraction of incident intensity reflected by a boundary.

title: Absorption Coefficient
description: Estimates the absorbed fraction when transmission through the boundary can be neglected.

title: Transmission Loss
description: Expresses how strongly a barrier reduces transmitted acoustic power.

title: Directivity Index
description: Converts a source directivity factor into decibels.

title: Critical Distance
description: Estimates the distance where direct and reverberant sound energies become approximately equal.

title: Beat Frequency
description: Calculates the amplitude-fluctuation rate produced by two nearby frequencies.

title: Frequency Difference in Cents
description: Expresses the pitch interval between two frequencies in cents.

title: Frequency from Cents Offset
description: Calculates a new frequency after applying a pitch offset in cents.

title: MIDI Note Frequency
description: Converts a MIDI note number into its equal-tempered frequency.

title: MIDI Note Number from Frequency
description: Calculates the corresponding equal-tempered MIDI note number from frequency.

title: Mid Signal
description: Extracts the center or common information from left and right channels.

title: Side Signal
description: Extracts the difference information responsible for much of stereo width.

title: Left from Mid/Side
description: Reconstructs the left channel from Mid and Side signals.

title: Right from Mid/Side
description: Reconstructs the right channel from Mid and Side signals.

title: Doppler Effect
description: Calculates observed frequency when the listener or source moves relative to the medium.
